s00460.summary: Tired Adaeze folds laundry while neighbor Gretchen notices a baby's sleeper.
Teo joins them and carefully folds the baby sleeper at his mother's request.

s00344.summary: Ingrid dangles in a crevasse while Solange and Dag haul her rope.
Ingrid reaches the lip and crawls out; Dag gently unwraps the rope from Solange's hands.

s01438.summary: Ward and Kroll creep through the refrigerated hold toward a particular crate.
They pry open the crate and find a preserved bride in antique lace.
The bride's eyelids flutter and a whisper rises; they hammer the lid shut.
Three polite knocks come from within the sealed crate.

s01649.summary: Petra, Leopold and onlookers converge at a crowded Venice vaporetto stop.
Leopold admits being a fool and begs Petra to stay as the last boat nears.
Petra takes the daisies, drops her suitcase into the water and lets the boat leave.

s00152.summary: Edmund and Liora wait silently in the pre-dawn kitchen amid unopened bills.
Quentin announces the auctioneer's truck is early; Edmund releases him to start on the tractor.
Edmund pushes the envelopes forward; Liora reads one and fills the kettle.

s02441.summary: Drive-through taxidermy clerk Darnell takes a customer's dead cat in a shoebox.
A manager's call reveals a forty-dollar cat surcharge; the impatient line honks behind.

s01577.summary: Simone drills her handcuffed client Dee on his alibi before court.
DA Lacroix arrives and shows pizza shop footage of a man in a hoodie.
Dee lunges up; Templeton and Simone restrain him as the tablet crashes down the steps.
Simone attacks the footage's chain of custody; Lacroix retorts and leaves a plea deadline.
Simone sits beside Dee and lets her shoulders drop.

s00633.summary: A soaked young man enters the ferry galley; the cook sees his face and goes still.
Philomena serves him soup, learns he is Leo and admits she always knew he existed.
They share silent soup and their hands meet on the counter.

s00495.summary: Three survivors count off in a capsized, flooding cabin with an hour of air.
They fight the hatch as the hull rolls and something white bumps the porthole.
Silence reveals a ship's engine overhead; they bang the hull to signal.

s01197.summary: Night-shift Nell finds a hooded figure in the shadows of the cannery.
Nell challenges the dripping figure, who knows her name from her apron.
The figure reveals herself as Nell's drowned mother, asking if she still sings.
A man appears with Nell's own face, saying they waited for her to come home.
The belts accelerate and Nell runs as the cannery hums a lullaby.

s01546.summary: Attorney Sabine urges anxious Dee to sit while a silent woman in grey waits.
Dee claims coworker Nicola told police she took the money.
The woman in grey rises and says she is Nicola.
Nicola confesses she took the money and blamed Dee because she'd be believed.
Sabine warns Nicola to stay silent; Nicola refuses and Dee slides down the mesh.
Sabine secures Nicola's promise to repeat it to judge and prosecutor and hands her a card.

s00976.summary: Employees in a former funeral home deadpan jabs at Pellingham's buzzword pivot.
Defeated, Pellingham climbs down and offers cake, possibly from the last funeral.

s01746.summary: Coach Ruiz criticizes Bex for standing still while the team trails by nine.
Captain Kalani sets the plan and jokes about making a whistle noise.
Tamsin is sick with nerves; Kalani vows to hit the wall for her.
The stopwatch clicks and the team skates out as the crowd stomps.

s00817.summary: A masked woman cashes out a huge stack of chips at the cashier cage.
Waiter Finnegan reveals a pistol and the two rob the cage, cheerfully polite.
Zinnia blinds the camera and they slip out with the cash.
Henry composes himself, then rings a small silver bell twice.

s01995.summary: In a Murano glass furnace hall, Zuanne and Serenella work while a nobleman intrudes.
Alvise insists on speaking to Serenella and then kneels, asking for her hand.
Zuanne's molten glass shatters, scattering everyone.
Alvise explains he proposed here because it was the honest place; Serenella and Zuanne weigh it.
Zuanne tells Alvise to learn to hold the furnace door, which he does.

s00502.summary: In the van, Brigitte complains the wedding cake leans like the Tower of Pisa.
Tamsin offers a skewer fix; Mirko organizes the team and Leonard holds the top tier.
The tier snaps straight and the four share relief and a quiet thanks.
The cake team is called up and the cake leans slightly again.

s02083.summary: Switchboard operator Adelaide banters with bellhop Floyd while handling calls.
She cuts off the man in 412 and admits she's being difficult tonight.
The board floods with calls; Adelaide returns to work and puts Clarence through to the front desk.

s01263.summary: Astronomer Lavinia rehearses her planetarium talk to empty seats, unaware a guard watches.
Guard Elian speaks up from the dark and compliments her; she invites him to stay.
Lavinia delivers the speech to him, revealing she studies light that arrives too late.
She sits in the row ahead and they watch the stars in silence.

s01272.summary: Wyatt goads Paks on a bus roof of a school bus graveyard.
They shove over a beer can and the roof booms.
A siren sounds and the three scramble off, laughing in the sunflowers.

s00153_1.summary: Four strangers stuck five hours in a gondola listen to the cable groan.
Nurse Rosalie tends Kieran's pain; Jasmine despairs the dead radio.
Augustin shares his thermos tea around the cabin.
The cabin lurches and swings wildly, then steadies.
Augustin toasts the view of the gorge he mapped; all four drink.

s01591.summary: Detectives track a carny holding a hostage through a mirror maze.
The carny fires at reflections and detectives take cover.
The carny laughs among countless footsteps.

s01433.summary: A heist crew cracks a case of pearls in the shark tunnel on a camera loop.
Guard Ilse rounds the corner, sips her tea and finds the crew with the pearls.
Vesper tells Ilse to sit and call it in later; she sits on the floor.

s01412.summary: Yusuf and Prisca struggle to force a warped airlock hatch as pressure drops.
The last valve breaks; they stare at each other as the hatch seals and lights die.

s00890.summary: Porter Paddy surprises a sleepless surgeon hiding in the noisy hospital laundry.
Ezekiel tells Paddy a thirty-one-year-old died on his table, leaving a young daughter.
Paddy sits knee to knee, shares his brother's story and offers a warm towel.
They exchange names and Ezekiel gets ready to return upstairs.
Ezekiel thanks Paddy for the towel; Paddy alone puts his cigarettes away.

s01793.summary: Agent Viktoria and Jude hide in a garage waiting for a handoff.
A silhouette receives an envelope from the sedan; Viktoria sees it's not their contact.
Mikhail steps from the shadows with a pistol and orders them out.
The sedan roars, shots fly and the van crashes as Viktoria escapes, leaving Jude cuffed.

s00125.summary: A stranger with a crowbar finds a cassette recorder alone in the storage unit.
A boy's recorded voice reveals the stranger is Desmond and points to a hidden key.
Desmond finds the brass key behind the third brick and walks out into the rain.

s00662.summary: A gray-bearded rider finishes his last coffee at dawn camp and talks to his horse.
He reads a letter saying the farm is sold and he cannot return, and gives his name Abel.
Abel tucks the letter away, hears a distant train whistle, remembers a letter and rides east.
